og_title: MAgIC: Benchmarking Large Language Model Powered Multi-Agent in Cognition, Adaptability, Rationality and Collaboration
og_description: MAgIC: A novel benchmarking framework specifically tailored to assess LLMs within multi-agent settings, providing quantitative metrics to evaluate their judgment, reasoning, deception, self-awareness, cooperation, coordination, and rationality.

outline.text: MAgIC: Investigation of Large Language Model PoweredMulti-Agent in Cognition, Adaptability, Rationality andCollaboration
How about current LLMs-powered Multi-agent's capabilities
We assess Multi-agent's abilities in Chameleon, Undercover, and Game Theory Scenarios (Cost Sharing, Prisoner’s Dilemma and Public Good)
PGM enhancement boosts the inherent abilities of all selected models by 50% on average!
